## About

I am a postdoctoral researcher at the Laboratoire des Sciences du Climat et de l'Environnement (LSCE). My interests are in **remote sensing and inversion methodologies** to understand the distribution of GHG fluxes across spheres. It sits at the intersection of satellite observation, atmospheric modeling, and GHG cycle science, aiming to close gaps in how we observe and attribute GHG sources and sinks at regional and global scales.

## Research Interests

<ul style="padding-left: 0.5px;">
  <li>Carbon cycle processes</li>
  <li>Global warming and its interlinkages</li>
  <li>Regional-scale dynamics of greenhouse gases (CO<sub>2</sub>, CH<sub>4</sub>, N<sub>2</sub>O)</li>
  <li>Carbon-climate interactions</li>
</ul>
